Provider icons as shown on openrouter.ai (fetched 2026-10-13), used on the home page cards to say who made each
page's models. The SVGs and PNGs come from `openrouter.ai/images/icons/` (the xAI and Z.ai ones from the favicon service
OpenRouter's own author pages use). PNGs are downscaled to 64px. The marks belong to their companies; shown only with `<img>`.
